_what: Letting someone see your Trillion, read only (src/view-as.mjs). The owner names the person by the email their Trillion account uses, or makes a one-use link the first signed-in person to open it takes (open for `link_open_days`), and for how many days (`days`, at most `most_days`); that person then sees a row for it on their Privacy screen and opens the owner's Home exactly as the owner sees it, read only: a look lasts at most `look_minutes` (or until the permission ends), refuses every change, keeps nothing on the looker's device, and the owner is told each time it is opened (notice kind `notice_kind`), with the newest `kept_looks` looks kept on their Privacy screen. Stopping the permission ends any look open now. `words` are every sentence the screens and notices say.

words.heading: Let someone see your Trillion
words.body: They see your Home exactly as you do, read only: they cannot change, send or delete anything. You are told every time they look, and you can stop it any time.
words.stop_confirm: Stop letting {who} look? Anything they have open closes now.
words.said_let: {who} can look at your Trillion until {until}. They will find it on their Privacy screen.
words.link_reveal: Send this link to the person. The first one to open it, signed in to Trillion, can look. It works once, for 7 days.
words.said_link: Link made. They can look for {days} after opening it.
words.no_account: No Trillion account uses that email yet. Ask them to sign up with it first.
words.bad_email: Type the email their Trillion account uses.
words.notice_body: Read only, for the next {minutes} minutes. Stop it on your Privacy screen.
words.looking_banner: You are looking at {name}'s Trillion. Read only, until {until}.
words.read_only: You are looking, read only. Nothing can be changed here.
words.ended: That permission has ended or was never given.
